production_contract: Existing parseIntelFeed public interface. Source-specific modules own validation; shared fetching, retries and storage stay unchanged.

usgs.envelope: FeatureCollection.features array. A provided metadata.count must match the returned feature count.
required_fields: Point coordinates: finite longitude, latitude and depth, with geographic range checks
usgs.unknown_fields: Publication time and event country remain null; optional measurements may be null.
usgs.empty_result: An empty feature array with coherent count=0 is legitimate.

gdacs.envelope: RSS channel with direct item children. Hidden items or a declared nonzero count with zero items must fail.
required_fields: supplied stable ID or explicitly derived URL/publication key
gdacs.optional_fields: Absent country/ISO3/point remain unknown. Missing fields do not authorize inference.
gdacs.time_semantics: fromdate and pubDate are independent. Supplied invalid dates fail validation; absent dates can remain null.
gdacs.geometry: Supplied latitude/longitude pairs must be finite and in range.
gdacs.empty_result: A correctly recognized, coherent RSS channel can legitimately be empty.

eonet.optional_geometry: Missing geometry remains null/unknown. Supplied geometry requires a valid type, coordinates and source datetime.
eonet.geometry: Documented Point/Polygon geometries. Non-Point projections must be labeled coordinate samples with total/stored counts and truncation; at most 16 pairs are stored.
eonet.unknown_fields: Publication time and event country remain null.
eonet.empty_result: An empty events array is legitimate.

un_zh.envelope: RSS channel with direct items. A provided feed language must match the Chinese endpoint.
un_zh.time_semantics: Absent publication time remains unknown; invalid supplied publication dates fail validation.
un_zh.geography: Chinese is a language, not an event-country assertion.
un_zh.content: Headlines, links and times only; no description, content:encoded or media.
un_zh.empty_result: A coherent recognized container can be empty. Wrong roots or nonzero-count/zero-item responses fail.

ecb.time_semantics: Supplied publication dates must be calendar-valid and offset-aware. Event time remains null.
ecb.geography: Publisher country Germany does not determine an event country.
ecb.empty_result: A coherent recognized channel can legitimately be empty.

bis_press.envelope: RSS 1 RDF root: item nodes are siblings of channel. Sequence references must be coherent with actual items.
bis_press.identity: Fallback URL/publication keys must be explicitly labeled derived.
bis_press.time_semantics: Source midnight dates carry exact-clock uncertainty; never label them event onset times.
bis_press.content: Limited metadata with BIS credit and a direct original link.
bis_press.empty_result: Zero items with zero sequence references is legitimate. Nonzero references with zero items or hidden items fail.

bis_speeches.envelope: Same RDF container/reference coherence as BIS press.
bis_speeches.time_semantics: Calendar-valid midnight dates remain exact-time-unverified. Event time remains null.
bis_speeches.geography: Swiss publisher jurisdiction is not the speech event country.
bis_speeches.empty_result: A coherent zero-reference RDF feed can be empty. Hidden or unprojected referenced items must not silently become zero.

required_fields: present price fields must be numbers or null
my_fuel_latest.time_semantics: Effective date remains date-only; publication and event timestamps remain null.
my_fuel_latest.content: Only approved price facts; unexpected narrative columns must never be persisted.
my_fuel_latest.empty_result: An empty array is structurally recognized, but it does not establish latest pricing availability.

required_fields: display title or heading sufficient for a deterministic derived identity
my_warning.time_semantics: Calendar-valid timezone-naive values are permitted and retained raw. Canonical times remain null until timezone semantics are verified.
my_warning.content: Only issue/title/heading/validity metadata, including a narrow nested issue allowlist. No full text or instructions.
my_warning.empty_result: An empty array can legitimately mean no warnings in the current snapshot.

nasa_metadata.envelope: JSON array. API error objects must fail.
required_fields: calendar-valid date_gmt and modified_gmt UTC strings
nasa_metadata.content: Requested metadata fields only. Never persist content, excerpt or media; title is bounded to 500 characters.
nasa_metadata.empty_result: An empty array can be legitimate for the requested rolling window. Runtime query dates must be generated, never taken from the fixture endpoint.
